quarterly_data.signal: L3Harris received an undefinitized contract award from Lockheed Martin valued at $4.7 billion over seven years to produce propulsion systems for the PAC-3 Missile Segment Enhancement (MSE) interceptor - its advanced two-pulse solid rocket motor, Lethality Enhancer and Attitude Control Motors - L3Harris's largest PAC-3 propulsion award to date, aligned with the long-term framework agreement with the Department of War. Two new PAC-3 MSE facilities on which it broke ground in June at Camden, Arkansas are expected to be operational in 2027; L3Harris is building approximately 60 new facilities and adding more than 1 million square feet of manufacturing space across Alabama, Virginia and Arkansas.
